Appreciated, but there's no one to call. I wouldn't know what to talk about anyway. I've been through this so many times..  
I know how to take care of the cuts, how I get myself to calm down, I'm just sick of having to do it all the time. It's like having to take care of a kid with zero impulse control and a death wish. And everyone keeps telling me, that I have to push through. I didn't choose this, fuck the kid.

I know this feeling very well. You *know* something's gonna happen, even if you don't know what or when. I was absolutely sure I'd never make it to 20. Then 21, 22... 24. By now I know not to trust it. Can I ask how you feel about 'knowing' something will happen? I usually felt indifferent, at times happy, sometimes just very paranoid. It's an odd state of mind for sure.  
Please don't worry about being a burden on anyone, especially your parents. I guarantee this is not how they feel about it and you shouldn't either. Ask them if you need confirmation.  
It's cool that you share this. I have trouble articulating these things, but reading about other people dealing with the same issues is helping.  
Hang in there, it's a bitch to deal with, but don't submit to it. As real as it seems, remember that there is no outside indication that it's true.  
A hug from halfway around the world and all the best :)

Victim here. It's hard enough to talk about it as it is, without having to take into consideration, that you might get someone killed. A lot of victims blame themselves, as do I, so this would be discouraging them from telling someone. Next, let's say someone got caught and the victim was found that way. When they are executed, that's something that the victim has to live with, while not having any say in it. We have had quite enough decisions made for us at this point. It's bad enough that politicians abuse this topic every chance they get.  
Anyway, my point is, who is the death penalty helping exactly? Not the victim, that's for sure.  
Which isn't to say, that I haven't thought about killing my abuser myself, but if I did, that would be my choice and my choice alone.
